_comment: Which surfaces of this repository are actually run, and how much weight a finding in each one carries. Read by the audit skills and checked by configs/scripts/check-layers.py. This exists because an audit spent most of its effort on a layer nobody runs.

statuses.load-bearing: Runs in the owner's normal workflow. A defect here is a defect.
statuses.dormant: Builds and passes CI, but is not run. Keep it green; weigh findings below load-bearing ones and treat new work here as opt-in rather than as debt.
statuses.generated: Produced from another surface by a regen script. Never edit directly; fix the source and regenerate.

layers.name: cli
layers.reason: The terminal is where all work happens. Every measured number in this repository comes from here or from the Claude Code layer it drives.
layers.notes: templates/orchestrator-settings.example.json inside the root templates/ directory is generated by configs/scripts/regen-settings-example.py; everything else here is hand-written and deployed by install.sh. `assets/` holds the README banner and social preview; `mcp/` holds the clade.mcp.json client config and its README. Both are hand-written and shipped, not generated.

layers.name: orchestrator
layers.reason: The web GUI is disabled by owner decision and the FastAPI server is not started in normal use. It may be rebuilt later, so it is kept building and green rather than deleted. Auditing an unrun system is how effort gets spent on a control that never applies.
layers.notes: Do not delete. Do not treat as debt. CI keeps it compiling and tested; that is the contract.

layers.name: mcp-package
layers.reason: Derived from configs/skills via mcp-package/skills.list. Regenerate with configs/scripts/regen-mcp-package.sh.

layers.name: codex-plugin
layers.reason: Derived from configs/skills via plugins/clade/skills.list. Regenerate with configs/scripts/regen-codex-plugin.py. Only skills/ is generated — the hooks, the skills.list manifest and .codex-plugin/plugin.json beside it are hand-maintained and belong to the cli layer.

layers.name: cc-plugin-agents
layers.reason: Generated mirror of configs/agents/ that the Claude Code plugin loader discovers by convention. Written by configs/scripts/regen-cc-plugin.py; the manifest carries no `agents` key, which is why the directory has to exist at the repo root. Never edit directly — fix configs/agents/ and regenerate.

layers.name: openclaw-adapter
layers.reason: Hand-written OpenClaw adapter — three skills plus a monitor service — that surfaces Clade loop status and control over a messaging channel. It talks to the orchestrator's HTTP API, which docs/layers.json declares dormant, so this cannot be in use either. Kept building; not deleted.
layers.notes: Weigh findings here with the orchestrator, below terminal-path work.
